task.title: Perform a commit and push to GitHub
task.shortdesc: This task explains how to save your changes locally and then send them to the remote repository.

taskbody.prereq: Have installed and a cloned repository.

step.cmd: Check the status of modified files.
Add files to the staging area.
step.info: git add . (all files) or git add filename

step.cmd: Push the commit to the remote main branch.

taskbody.result: Your changes are now visible on .
